verdict.rationale: Brave documents a dedicated Answers service providing "AI-generated answers backed by real-time web search and verifiable sources," grounded on one or more searches. It supports streaming and is accessed through the OpenAI SDK, which implies a single chat-completion-style call. The older summarizer flow needs two steps (a web search with summary:true, then a summary-key fetch), but the Answers endpoint appears to remove that. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or example showing one request returns both the answer and its citations, documentation of the source/citation response format, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
